components: a short falling stroke at the top
a short stem on the left
strokeOrder: draw the short falling stroke at the top, down to the left
lift, draw the top bar from left to right
lift, draw the second bar from left to right
lift, draw the short stem on the left, down from the second bar
lift, draw the long third bar from left to right
lift, draw the long centre stem from the top bar straight down through the others
strokeOrderNote: KanjiVG, kanji/05e74.svg (https://github.com/KanjiVG/kanjivg/blob/master/kanji/05e74.svg), records 年 (U+5E74) as six stroke paths, kvg:05e74-s1 to s6, in this order and direction (Ulrich Apel and contributors, CC BY-SA 3.0). KanjiVG stores each stroke as one directed path in writing order: s1 is the short falling stroke at the top, drawn down to the left (kvg:type ㇒); s2 is the top bar, drawn left to right (㇐); s3 is the second bar, drawn left to right (㇐); s4 is the short stem on the left, drawn down from the second bar (㇑a); s5 is the long third bar, drawn left to right (㇐); s6 is the long centre stem, drawn from the top bar down through the second and third (㇑). Only the order and direction are taken from that file. No ductus geometry has been fitted to the Noto Sans JP outline for this kanji yet, so the row carries no verified pen-lift count or structured source (script-ductus holds every such claim to a ductus): the lessons teach it copy-only, from this order.
notes: Year. Read nen in 年じゅう nenjū, all year round; toshi is its reading standing alone.
